Start date: 1250-09-22  
Add 40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Add 4 more days → total 284 days.  

1250 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days from Sep 22 to end of 1250:  
Sep: 8 days left (30-22)  
Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total = 8+31+30+31 = 100 days.  

284 − 100 = 184 days into 1251.  
1251 is not a leap year.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 →  
31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days (end of Jun).  
184 − 181 = 3 days into July → July 3, 1251.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1251-07-03
